business_summary: Xinjiang Tianye Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, produces and sells chemical products in China and internationally. The company offers chemical products, including industrial sodium hydroxide, polyvinyl chloride resin, ethylene glycol, butanediol, suspension method general-purpose polyvinyl chloride resin, micro-suspension method for polyvinyl chloride paste resin, sodium hypochlorite solution, hydrochloric and caustic acid, suspension process polyvinyl chloride specialty resin, matte polyvinyl chloride resin, n-butanol, solid mercury catalyst, and light calcium carbonate. It also provides water-saving products, such as single-wing labyrinth and embedded drip tapes, nanomaterial modified water hose, low-density polyvinyl chloride pipes for sprinkler irrigation, agricultural rigid polyvinyl chloride pipes, and pressure-compensating drip irrigation pipe; cement products comprising general-purpose silicate cement clinker, general-purpose silicate cement, and special cement; and plastic products, which include polyethylene blown agricultural ground cover film, polyvinyl chloride wood-plastic composite building formwork, unplasticized polyvinyl chloride plastic windows, and unplasticized polyvinyl chloride profiles for doors and windows. In addition, the company offers packaging products, such as plastic woven bags, flexible intermediate bulk containers, heavy packaging films, and cement packaging bags; and food-related products. Further, it is involved in housing rental; chemical product trading; road and rail freight transport; bulk material procurement and sale; and coal washing, processing, manufacturing, and sale. The company's products are used in thermal power, chemicals and new materials, calcium carbide, cement, water-saving equipment, agriculture, commerce and logistics, and mineral development fields. It exports its products. The company was founded in 1996 and is headquartered in Shihezi, China.
business_summary_ko: Xinjiang Tianye Co., Ltd.는 자회사와 함께 중국 및 해외에서 화학 제품을 생산 및 판매합니다. 이 회사는 산업용 수산화나트륨, 폴리염화비닐 수지, 에틸렌글리콜, 부탄디올, 현탁법 범용 폴리염화비닐 수지, 폴리염화비닐 페이스트 수지의 미세 현탁법, 차아염소산나트륨 용액, 염산 및 가성산, 현탁법 폴리염화비닐 특수 수지, 무광택 폴리염화비닐 수지, n-부탄올, 고체 수은 촉매, 경질 탄산칼슘 등의 화학 제품을 제공합니다. 또한 단일 날개 미로 및 내장 드립 테이프, 나노 소재 개질 물 호스, 스프링클러 관개용 저밀도 폴리염화비닐 파이프, 농업용 경질 폴리염화비닐 파이프 및 압력 보상형 점적 관개 파이프와 같은 물 절약 제품을 제공합니다. 범용 규산염 시멘트 클링커, 범용 규산염 시멘트 및 특수 시멘트로 이루어진 시멘트 제품; 폴리에틸렌 블로운 농업용 그라운드 커버 필름, 폴리염화비닐 목재-플라스틱 복합 건물 거푸집, 비가소화 폴리염화비닐 플라스틱 창 및 UN을 포함하는 플라스틱 제품
